name: codex-research-loop
description: Project-local research workflow memory, prompt normalization, adaptive storage policies, content ingest, standardized data packages, source lookup, Zotero/wiki exports, claim-evidence verification, deep-loop gate review routing, isolated problem-loop expert diagnosis, fail-open external supervisor review, unattended test loops, checkpoints, handoffs, lifecycle logs, and skill routing for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Route resumable research projects with adaptive storage, ingest, evidence checks, deep-loop gate reviews, isolated problem diagnosis, and test feedback loops.
interface.longDescription: Codex Research Loop adds project-local research state, project profiles, prompt normalization for incomplete natural-language requests, adaptive project-facing storage policies, canonical or existing-repo-compatible research layouts, explicit URL/local-file content ingest, article-processing packages, standardized data packages with raw bytes, metadata, schema, README, source metadata lookup through public scholarly APIs, Zotero-compatible collection plans, BibTeX and CSL-JSON exports, PDF attachment plans, llm-wiki-compatible pages, deterministic claim-evidence verification over evidence ids, sources, locators, and statuses, deep-loop gate evaluation that routes every pass through review_for_transition and every failed gate through review_for_retry, isolated problem-loop diagnosis with repo/context analysis, generated expert panels, captured test logs, adjustment plans, and gated promotion before core edits, fail-open external supervisor review for watchdog decisions, unattended validation/test/repair loops, updateable research records, checkpoints, handoff files, command run logs, lifecycle hook scripts, MCP tools, multi-path task graphs, capability matrices, missing-tool gap reporting, and routing to academic, Nature-style, document, figure, and presentation skills.
defaultPrompt: Start a research loop for this project.
Show the current research loop status.

Ingest this dataset as a standardized data package.
Export recorded sources to Zotero and wiki pages.
Verify claim evidence links before writing.
Diagnose this blocker with the isolated problem loop.
Run the unattended auto loop until tests pass.
Pair DeepSeek by setting DEEPSEEK_API_KEY so the fail-open external supervisor can run.
